source.author: cic
source.text: etenim, ut ait Homerus, ex eius lingua melle dulcior fluebat oratio; quam ad suavitatem nullis egebat corporis viribus.
source.text_original: etenim, ut ait Homerus, ex eius lingua melle dulcior fluebat oratio; quam ad suavitatem nullis egebat corporis  viribus.
source.text_english: Indeed, as Homer says, speech flowed from his tongue sweeter than honey; for such charm it needed no bodily strength.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: certe Homerus refert, quod de lingua Nestoris iam uetuli et paene decrepiti dulcior melle oratio fluxerit .
reuse.text_original: certe Homerus refert, quod de lingua Nestoris iam uetuli et paene decrepiti dulcior melle oratio fluxerit .
reuse.text_english: Certainly Homer relates that from the tongue of Nestor, already very old and almost decrepit, speech flowed sweeter than honey.
